arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
PY="$BASE/envs/openwebui/bin/python"
"$PY" - <<'PY'
import os,hashlib,tempfile,subprocess,shutil,json
BASE="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp"
envp=BASE+"/ollama-runtime.env"
backup=BASE+"/backups/ollama-residency-bounded-20261003T0405Z"
expected_sha="4514bcd3f855895524c7ebd8f55913b2d6d2ba32270bde295d687a852fc95e49"
old_line="export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1"
new_line="export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=10m"
warm1="@reboot /home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh >/dev/null 2>&1"
warm2="*/10 * * * * /home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh >/dev/null 2>&1"
raw=open(envp,"rb").read()
sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
if sha!=expected_sha:
    raise SystemExit("CAS_ABORT env sha "+sha)
text=raw.decode("utf-8")
for invariant in (
    "export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1",
    "export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1",
    "export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096",
):
    if text.count(invariant)!=1:
        raise SystemExit("CAS_ABORT invariant "+invariant)
if text.count(old_line)!=1:
    raise SystemExit("CAS_ABORT keep_alive line")
cp=subprocess.run(["crontab","-l"],capture_output=True,text=True)
if cp.returncode not in (0,1):
    raise SystemExit("CAS_ABORT crontab read rc="+str(cp.returncode))
cron=cp.stdout
lines=cron.splitlines()
if lines.count(warm1)!=1 or lines.count(warm2)!=1:
    raise SystemExit("CAS_ABORT warm residency cron count")
os.makedirs(backup,mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(envp,backup+"/ollama-runtime.env.before")
with open(backup+"/crontab.before","w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(cron)
os.chmod(backup+"/crontab.before",0o600)
newtext=text.replace(old_line,new_line,1)
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".ollama-runtime.",dir=BASE)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f:
        f.write(newtext.encode("utf-8")); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.chmod(tmp,0o600)
    os.replace(tmp,envp)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)
newlines=[ln for ln in lines if ln not in (warm1,warm2)]
fd,ctmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".crontab.",dir=backup)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(newlines)+("\n" if newlines else "")); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    rc=subprocess.run(["crontab",ctmp]).returncode
    if rc!=0:
        shutil.copy2(backup+"/ollama-runtime.env.before",envp)
        raise SystemExit("CRONTAB_INSTALL_FAILED env rolled back")
finally:
    if os.path.exists(ctmp): os.unlink(ctmp)
after=open(envp,"rb").read()
after_sha=hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()
cp2=subprocess.run(["crontab","-l"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
if warm1 in cp2.stdout or warm2 in cp2.stdout:
    raise SystemExit("POSTCHECK_FAIL warm cron remains")
for invariant in (
    "export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=10m",
    "export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1",
    "export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1",
    "export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096",
):
    if invariant not in after.decode("utf-8"):
        raise SystemExit("POSTCHECK_FAIL "+invariant)
print("REPAIR=PASS")
print("BACKUP_DIR="+backup)
print("ENV_SHA_BEFORE="+sha)
print("ENV_SHA_AFTER="+after_sha)
print("ENV_KEEP_ALIVE=10m")
print("WARM_RESIDENCY_CRON=REMOVED")
print("OTHER_CRON_LINES="+str(len(newlines)))
PY
echo '--- RELEVANT_CRON_AFTER ---'
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -E 'ollama-keepalive|warm-residency|concurrency-ledger-service' || true
echo '--- ENV_AFTER ---'
grep -E '^export OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|CONTEXT_LENGTH)=' "$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
